channel.title: BusinessHub.cy — Business
channel.description: Latest Business stories from BusinessHub.cy, Cyprus Edition.

item.title: Statement by Eurogroup President Kyriakos Pierrakakis on the nominations for the post of ECB executive board members
item.description: France and Germany have nominated Laurence Boone and Markus Brunnermeier to fill two upcoming vacancies on the European Central Bank’s Executive Board.

item.title: Global Emerging Markets Risk Database (GEMs)
item.description: The EIB and IFC have made the GEMs database, a 40-year repository of emerging market credit risk data, publicly accessible for investors.

item.title: Share of government debt held by resident financial corporations highest in Czechia and Sweden
item.description: Cyprus ranks among the EU leaders for government debt held by non-residents, highlighting a significant reliance on international investors for sovereign financing.

item.title: EU records over 560 000 mastectomies in 2024
item.description: Eurostat reports over 560,000 mastectomies across the EU in 2024, highlighting significant healthcare demands and the growing need for specialized oncology and rehabilitation services.

item.title: Children in the EU – check our new infographic for more
item.description: Eurostat has released a comprehensive new infographic detailing demographic and social statistics regarding children across the European Union, including Cyprus.

item.title: Are households with kids becoming less common in EU?
item.description: Eurostat data reveals a significant decline in EU households with children, with Cyprus experiencing one of the sharpest drops over the last decade.

item.title: OECD Economic Survey of Indonesia 2026 – Thursday 26 November
item.description: The OECD is set to release its 2026 Economic Survey of Indonesia and a specialized report on the country's semiconductor ecosystem on November 25-26.

item.title: Slush 2026: RIF backs Cyprus’ largest delegation of 25 innovative companies
item.description: RIF: Cyprus at SLUSH 2026 with 25 innovative companies participating in the national delegation For the first time, 25 Cypriot companies took part in the international innovation event in Helsinki, marking the sixth consecutive RIF-supported mission and highlighting the growth and evolution of…

item.title: The EIB Group establishes stricter ethical standards with clear rules on conflict of interest and cooling off periods
item.description: The EIB Group has updated its Staff Code of Conduct to strengthen ethical standards, conflict of interest rules, and cooling-off periods.

item.title: Establishment of Cyprus-Palestine Business Association
item.description: The Cyprus Chamber of Commerce and Industry (CCCI) is seeking expressions of interest to form a Cyprus–Palestine Business Association to boost bilateral trade and investment.

item.title: Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices - Annual Rate of Change 5,4% (Oct 2026)
item.description: Cyprus' Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices rose by 5.4% in October 2026, signaling persistent inflationary pressures across the local economy.

item.title: GBCY Business Orientation Cyprus 2026 concludes with resounding success
item.description: The annual conference brought together business leaders, investors and advisers from Cyprus, the United Kingdom and beyond to explore investment opportunities and build cross-border relationships.

item.title: QUBE Events successfully concludes its 27th NextGen Payments & RegTech Forum in Limassol
item.description: Payments leaders, RegTech specialists and compliance experts gathered at the Four Seasons Hotel to discuss agentic AI, real-time fraud prevention and the future of European payments.

item.title: 8.5% EU people aged 15-74 had STEM tertiary education
item.description: Eurostat data reveals that 8.5% of the EU population holds a STEM tertiary degree, highlighting significant talent gaps and gender disparities across the union.

item.title: European Statistical Monitor: November edition
item.description: Eurostat’s November monitor highlights a mixed EU recovery with rising industrial production but persistent inflation, signaling the need for cautious financial planning in Cyprus.

item.title: Air travel made up 17.2% of trips in 2025
item.description: Eurostat reports air travel accounted for 17.2% of all EU tourism trips in 2025, highlighting the aviation sector's critical role in the regional travel market.

item.title: Infocredit Professional Education holds two-day credit management and debt collection seminar in Nicosia
item.description: Led by Nicos Ioannou, the seminar used real-world case studies to explore customer credit risk assessment, receivables management and negotiation techniques.

item.title: QUBE Events opens the 27th NextGen Payments & RegTech Forum in Limassol
item.description: Payments, compliance and technology leaders from Cyprus, Europe and beyond gather to discuss real-time payments, agentic AI and the future of European financial regulation.

item.title: Cyprus Participation in the 20th International Architecture Exhibition – La Biennale di Venezia 2027
item.description: Cyprus launches an open call for a Curator for its 2027 Venice Biennale pavilion, securing a prestigious new location within the Arsenale to showcase local architectural innovation.

item.title: The Ambassador of Cyprus to Iran presents his credentials
item.description: Ambassador Antonis Mandritis officially presented his credentials to Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian, reaffirming diplomatic ties and a commitment to regional stability.

item.title: The High Commissioner of Cyprus to South Africa presents his credentials
item.description: The new High Commissioner to South Africa, Stelios Makriyiannis, presented his credentials, focusing on economic cooperation and the influential role of the Cypriot diaspora.

item.title: EU counted 45 road fatalities per million people in 2024
item.description: Cyprus recorded 37 road fatalities per million inhabitants in 2024, performing better than the EU average of 45 despite a slight increase in deaths compared to 2023.

item.title: Asylum applications in August 2026
item.description: Cyprus recorded the highest rate of first-time asylum applications in the EU relative to its population for August 2026, maintaining significant pressure on national infrastructure.

item.title: Record number of students from abroad in the EU
item.description: New Eurostat data reveals a record number of international students across the EU, highlighting Cyprus's growing status as a regional educational hub.

item.title: CITEA at the heart of China's Technology landscape: startegic engagements with HUAWEI, ALIBABA, TEMU AND MINIMAX
item.description: New opportunities for cooperation are emerging for Cypriot technology companies following CITEA’s recent mission to China, which focused on building connections with leading technology organisations, exchanging expertise and exploring synergies for the development and promotion of innovative…

item.title: Road Freight Transport - Freight transport in Cyprus +2,3% and from and to Cyprus +17,7% (2nd Quarter 2026)
item.description: Cyprus road freight transport grew in Q2 2026, with a significant 17.7% surge in international cargo alongside a modest 2.3% rise in domestic movement.

item.title: AbleBook’s Andreas Vasiliou Takes On His First Marathon as Community Team Runs and Rolls for Inclusion
item.description: AbleBook, Stoiximan Wheels of Change and Yparxo opened their 5 km Corporate Race team to the public, while Vasiliou and teammate Marios Antonios Marshall lined up for their first full marathon in Larnaka.

item.title: Economist 22nd Annual Cyprus Summit Panagiotou
item.description: The Economist 22nd Annual Cyprus Summit, scheduled for November 2026, will address regional cooperation, geopolitics, and investment opportunities in Nicosia.

item.title: OEB promotes Hydrogen Valleys in Cyprus
item.description: OEB participates in the EU-funded TRIERES project to develop Green Hydrogen Valleys, aiming to transfer technical expertise and sustainable energy infrastructure models to Cyprus.

item.title: Media advisory - Foreign Affairs Council of 16 November 2026
item.description: EU Foreign Ministers will meet on November 16 to discuss winter support for Ukraine and counter-measures against Russian hybrid threats affecting member states.

item.title: Infocredit Group’s ComplianceSuite wins Gold for Best Compliance Platform
item.description: The Cyprus-developed platform, recognised at the 2026 Compliance Awards, brings customer onboarding, AML screening, transaction monitoring and case management into one workflow.

item.title: Nepal Stabilizes Its Economy—and Sets Its Sights Higher
item.description: Nepal has achieved macroeconomic stability through structural reforms, shifting focus toward accelerating inclusive growth and long-term economic resilience.

item.title: IMF Staff Reaches Staff Level Agreement with Armenia on the Second Review of the Stand-By Arrangement (SBA) and request for a Resilience and Sustainability Facility (RSF)
item.description: The IMF reaches a staff-level agreement with Armenia, potentially unlocking significant financial support and enhancing regional economic stability.

item.title: IMF Staff Concludes Visit to Lebanon
item.description: IMF staff visited Lebanon to advance banking sector restructuring, but a final agreement remains pending as laws must align with international standards to ensure financial stability.

item.title: Pavlos Phokas calls for a stronger role for Cyprus shipyards in defence programmes
item.description: Multimarine Services’ Chief Commercial Officer highlighted how local shipyards and marine engineering firms could support Cyprus’ Ministry of Defence and help turn defence investment into skilled jobs.

item.title: EU economy greenhouse gas emissions: -0.5% in Q2 2026
item.description: EU greenhouse gas emissions declined by 0.5% in Q2 2026 despite economic activity, highlighting a continued trend toward decoupling growth from environmental impact.

item.title: EU consumption expenditure grows, alcohol & tobacco dip
item.description: Eurostat data reveals a rise in overall EU household consumption expenditure, contrasting with a decline in spending on alcohol and tobacco products.

item.title: Ablebook co-founders present app for finding accessible places across Cyprus
item.description: Andreas Vasiliou and Symeon Stylianou presented Ablebook, a Cyprus-developed app that helps people with disabilities check venue facilities, find designated parking and plan visits in advance.

item.title: ASBIS joins “From Grant to Growth” panel at Plug and Play Cyprus Expo
item.description: As a founding corporate partner ASBIS supported the Plug and Play Cyprus Expo alongside Mastercard, Tototheo Global and ECOMMBX. The Expo took place on November 11 at Etko in Limassol and marked the completion of the first cohort of the Plug and Play Cyprus Acceleration Program, with 10 startups…

item.title: GDP Growth Rate - Growth Rate 3,1% (seasonally adjusted) - 3rd Quarter 2026 (Flash Estimate)
item.description: Cyprus GDP grew by 3.1% in Q3 2026, signaling sustained economic resilience and outperforming the broader Eurozone average.

item.title: Call Centre Cyprus wins Gold for Sophia for Children partnership
item.description: The initiative reactivated 64 sponsors and generated €5,220 in donations, helping 64 children continue receiving support through the Adopt a Child programme

item.title: Value of agriculture output hits record high in 2025
item.description: The EU agricultural industry reached a record output value of €537.1 billion in 2025, driven by price increases despite fluctuating production volumes.

item.title: 2.3 million tonnes of textile waste generated in 2024
item.description: The EU produced 2.3 million tonnes of textile waste in 2024, signaling urgent regulatory shifts toward circular economy practices and mandatory collection across member states.

item.title: Emergency oil stocks slightly down; commercial stocks up in July 2026
item.description: July 2026 data shows a slight decline in EU emergency oil stocks, partially offset by an increase in commercial reserves.

item.title: Commissioner for Administration and the Protection of Human Rights – Regional Conference
item.description: Cyprus celebrates the 35th anniversary of the Ombudsman institution, highlighting its role in human rights protection and administrative accountability within the Republic.

item.title: Women made up 41% of EU scientists & engineers in 2025
item.description: Eurostat data reveals women now represent 41% of the EU's 15.3 million scientists and engineers, highlighting a steady trend toward gender parity in technical sectors.

item.title: Temporary protection for 4.37 million in September 2026
item.description: As of September 2026, 4.37 million Ukrainians benefit from EU temporary protection, with Cyprus hosting 20,495 individuals, reflecting a steady labor pool and social service demand.

item.title: Foreign direct investment: where is it coming from?
item.description: Eurostat data highlights the dominance of the US and UK in EU foreign direct investment, signaling critical trends for Cyprus as an international financial hub.

item.title: Almost 30% unable to cope with unexpected expenses
item.description: Eurostat data reveals nearly 30% of the EU population lacks the financial reserves to handle unexpected expenses, highlighting significant household financial vulnerability.

item.title: New automated notification service for applications and residence documents
item.description: The Migration Department has launched a new automated SMS and email notification system for residence applications and document expiries, requiring a CY Login account.
